'''Fars Sil-at''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Amani/Legends|Amani]] who [[Bartender/Legends|operated]] the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Sil's Place]] in [[Westport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Sil-at served as secret supporter on the anti-Imperial [[Whiplash]] resistance group. He met with various other senior members of the group aboard a [[Whiplash Express|hovertrain]] that served as their interim headquarters, to discuss how the Whiplash would react to the recent capture of their leader, [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], by the Empire. At the suggestion of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Tuden Sal]], leadership of the Whiplash passed to the [[Whiplash Council]], and Sil-at served as a member of the council. Under Sal's influence, the Whiplash launched an [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|ill-fated attack]] on the [[Emperor's Villa]] near the [[Western Sea]], and Sil-at [[Death/Legends|perished]] as a result of the debacle.
